names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ερμάς, Πατρόβας, Λίνος, Γάιος και Φιλόλογος, Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Святитель Филолог, епископ Синопский, апостол от 70-ти», with the rank words and the see left off; the see is recorded as the office. The line itself gives the name in the genitive.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. новембар ст. ст., „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“ — «Св. апостоли» left off, and the heading gives the five nothing but five bare names in the nominative, so the fifth of them is the whole of the form (section 6). It is the IDENTICAL STRING this folder already stores for `ru`, which is two calendars agreeing and not a duplicate; `sr-foldpred.mjs` reports it adds no new fold key. «of Sinope» in the display name is the see both books give him.

feast.note: The name page also lists «4 января (70 ап.)», the synaxis of the Seventy Apostles, which is a synaxis and not a second feast; this folder renders on 5 ноября ст. ст. only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 ноября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.11.2025 (5. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“

attestations.note: The fifth name of the day’s second entry, an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF FIVE with no «и други» at the end, so all five folders take the same one heading, whole, with its closing full stop. URL year 2025. `types` AND `office` UNTOUCHED AND THE TWO BOOKS AGREE ON HIS SEE: «Филолог у Синопи (Рим. 15, 16)», bishop in Sinope, which is the Bishop of Sinope already in `office`. «Св. апостоли» is the `apostle` and «Беху из седамдесет апостола» the Seventy. `dates` UNTOUCHED at the first century: no year at all. THE REFERENCE IS COPIED AS PRINTED AND NOT CORRECTED: «(Рим. 15, 16)», where the name stands at Romans 16, 15 and the two numbers read as transposed, which is the same shape as the Hermas reference in the same sentence and is the source’s and not the scrape’s. NO `locations`, NO `related` ROW: the other four are `related` here in both directions already. NO FOLD: the `sr` form is the identical string this folder already stores in `ru`, so it adds no key of its own. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
